description:
真正擊潰我的，不單單只是失去了一段感情。 而是在那個難忘的月份裡，對我來說僅存的遮羞布，被狠狠撕了下來。 我只好第一次那麼直接的，面對自己的失敗，一事無成。 分手之後的那段時間，我其實很害怕去碰觸「愛」這件事情。 看到韓劇裡男女主角甜膩的擁抱、親吻，甚至只是一個眼神，都會察覺到 「嗯，我好像已經忘記了。」 忘記了喜歡一個人是什麼感覺，忘記了親吻一個人的感覺，也忘記了為一個人深呼吸、嘆氣，究竟是什麼樣的心情。 又或者，是因為害怕再次失去，所以開始退卻。 「如果我真的再也沒有辦法愛上一個人了呢？」 如果連該怎麼擁抱一個人，怎麼相信一段感情，甚至期待一個人走進我的生命，都變成了一件需要鼓起很大勇氣的事情呢？ 於是我寫下了〈怎麼會〉。 那時候的我，已經沒有力氣，再一次去索求一個不值得擁有的夢。 少在寫下這首歌的當下，我只想承認一件事， 我真的，很害怕再愛了。 - 製作人 Producer | Control T 作詞人 Lyricist |   李妮蓁 Nichen Lee/黃正嘉 Zheng Jia Huang 作曲人 Composer | 黃正嘉 Zheng Jia Huang 編曲 Music Arranger | 陳信伯 Hsinpo Chen /Control T 合聲編寫 Backing Vocal Arranger | 李妮蓁 Nichen Lee/黃正嘉 Zheng Jia Huang 主唱 Lead Vocalist | 李妮蓁 Nichen Lee/黃正嘉 Zheng Jia Huang 電吉他 Electric Guitar |呂理鈞 jimjim 木吉他 Acoustic Guitar | 黃正嘉 Zheng Jia Huang 人聲編輯 Vocal Editing | 呂理鈞 jimjim 錄音師 Recording Engineer | 黃渝傑 UJay Huang 混音師 Mixing Engineer |   陳信伯 Hsinpo Chen 母帶後期工程師 Mastering Engineer |  陳信伯 Hsinpo Chen 錄音室 Recording Studio | One Stroke Studio

在從群山駛回首爾的大客車上，所有人都睡著了，除了司機大哥和我，我看著窗外那不知名的湖泊、或河川、或江流，又忍不住想起前一晚在渡假村的慶功宴，想起那片抬頭就能望見的星空。為了把這份幸福保存起來，在搖晃的車裡寫了這首歌《獨木舟》，送給此刻遠在韓國的Esther教授、Woojin老師、Gyeonghwan哥、Roun哥、Zizi姐和Jimin姐。 寫好歌之後，等到回國，自己在房間簡單地，打開筆電，對著打電動跟隊友溝通用的麥克風自彈自唱，錄了這整首歌，然後簡單地自己後製，前後加總大概用了一週時間吧。至於影片的剪輯，基本上就是圍繞著這首《獨木舟》而製作，幾乎把計劃十六天中所有拍的素材都丟進來了，一共分成五個章節：湖原就業支援中心、見學、穿過人海、不眠之夜、結局，沒有其他旁白或解說字幕，只有一幕接一幕的畫面，用鏡頭述說這段難忘的故事。 還是讓大家知道一下我們「夢想ON AIR 光芒養成記」在幹嘛。首日落地首爾後，連續五天地獄行程練舞，第七天到群山市參與當地傳統藝術節的舞台演出，是唯一來自海外的表演團體。第八天就是群山渡假村慶功宴，第九天回首爾，寫下了這首歌，之後幾天陸續接受了舞蹈、演技與聲樂課程之外，也參訪許多機構、美術展覽和音樂劇場，包含去了KBS公司、SM UNIVERSE、鄭瑄茉美妝教室、德壽宮、馬羅尼矣公園等等。計畫尾聲則是有明洞、聖水洞、弘大等地的自由行程。 總歸一句話就是：好想要時間倒退回八月十六日，我能再幸福一次。 詞 Lyricist｜林宥丞 曲 Composer｜ 林宥丞 製作 Producer｜林宥丞 編曲 Music Arranger｜林宥丞 配唱製作 Vocal Producer｜林宥丞 木吉他 Acoustic Guitar｜林宥丞 錄音師 Recording Engineer｜林宥丞(AG/Vocal) 錄音室 Recording Studio｜林宥丞的房間 人聲編輯 Vocal Editing｜林宥丞 混音師 Mixing Engineer｜林宥丞

description:
《自由·知義》創作理念 《自由·知義》是一首關於故鄉、土地、族群認同與自由的歌。對許多人而言，「知義」或許只是地圖上經過的一個名稱；但對我而言，這裡是我生命與音樂夢想啟航的起點。 小時候我住在知義里口埤，在那裡成長、第一次接觸音樂、站上舞台。多年後我重返知義里，在新和庄重新落腳，心中多了一份「熟悉卻陌生」的深刻體會。作為一名泰雅族青年，看著西拉雅文化逐漸被世人看見與正名，我為那個曾在這片土地成長的自己，感到一份真實而驕傲的榮譽感。 這首歌串聯了 Tavogan、Siraya、Mariyang，並以台語描繪知義派出所的茶葉蛋香與黃土深根的蕃薯。這些庶民生活符號，不僅是所長茶葉蛋與瓜瓜園等地方記憶，更是無數人在這片土地上用汗水交織出的美夢。 歌名《自由·知義》致敬了《進擊的巨人》中的「自由之翼」。「曾經以為長大就能飛翔」，象徵離鄉追尋自由；但走得越遠才發現——自由不是逃離所有束縛的高牆，而是有能力回頭，坦然擁抱自己的來處。 「知義」不只是地名，它是我的故鄉，也是我重新定義自由的起點。

《一個往前，一個往後》 有些感情，並不是不愛了， 只是兩個人對「靠近」有著不同的答案。 一個害怕失去，所以不停往前； 一個害怕失去自己，所以慢慢往後。 明明都還深愛著彼此， 卻在一次次靠近與退後之間， 逐漸聽不見對方真正想說的話。 《一個往前，一個往後》寫的， 不是誰對誰錯， 而是兩個同樣害怕失去的人， 用不同的方式守護著自己的愛。 也許愛不一定是緊緊抓住， 也不一定是轉身放手。 有時候，是在彼此不同的距離裡， 慢慢學會理解， 也學會相信—— 你退後，不代表你不愛我； 而我靠近，也不代表我想把你困住。 編曲選擇以古典吉他獨奏為主， 讓簡單而溫暖的琴弦， 承接歌曲裡那些沒有說出口的情緒。 願這首歌， 送給每一個曾經在愛裡 一個往前、一個往後的人。

lyrics:
That was the split. I stayed on my side of the world. I poured a glass of wine, watched the level fall, and suddenly the room grew wide. Ce n’est pas du regret, c’est la physique. 這不是遺憾，只是物理定律。 Your face half lost inside the light. At last I saw you clearly, and the place I kept inside went quiet enough for me to hear the room reply. Two seeds from the same tree. On a compris plus tard, 我們後來才明白， we didn’t simply trade our lives. Nous étions chacun 我們各自都在 à mesurer jusqu’où l’âme pouvait aller. 丈量靈魂究竟能走多遠。 You’re the version of me that left. Je suis la version de toi qui est restée. 我是那個留下來的你。 I’m the one who held the little light you left. Tu es la route que je n’ai pas choisie. 你是那條我沒有選擇的路。 The road split open, but the roots stayed the same. No debt, no victory, nothing left to claim. You said you wanted une vie plus tranquille. 一種更平靜的生活。 I nodded, looking toward my own future. No envy, no pride. Some answers take this many years before they finally become clear. You lived the life I didn’t choose. J’ai gardé la maison que tu as dû perdre. 我守住了那個你不得不失去的家。 I kept the part of you that stayed behind. Après toutes ces années, 過了這麼多年， je porte encore ton nom dans le silence. 我依然在沉默裡帶著你的名字。 It’s one long breath held for decades, finally released between us. 想一下，算了，就醬吧。
抱著吉他坐下來，幾個孩子慢慢靠過來。有人唱低一點，有人硬要唱高一點，也沒誰真的管得住誰。唱著唱著，居然成了和聲。遠一點的孩子跟著喊，聲音從山那邊又繞回來。
那天沒有錄到我們原本準備的歌，因為導演的電池沒電。
如果你很想知道這個故事是不是真人實事：其實我是發現虎頭蜂的那個，老師應該是叫做 Macing。

Everybody, the mountain wind blows past the field. Teacher Minzer calls out loud: Today we’ll make the song real! The director called the teacher, said the children had to come. They had practiced for two months. Today we’d record the song. Faces washed and shirts all shining, through the school gate, one by one. Every little smiling troublemaker— look how innocent they’ve become! Lined up across the playing field, one child spun around and round. Someone’s missing one whole shoe, someone’s chasing a hornet down. One is waving at the camera, one has climbed a tree instead. Minzer shouts, “Left side! Right side!” Every child runs somewhere else! Let the whole mountain hear us! Ha-ha-ha, the children sing! Clean white shirts and muddy knees, plans fall down—let the party begin! Everybody say: We may not record a thing today! Minzer and the children, side by side, grace is waiting on the hillside! The director said, “The little ones in front, put the taller children behind.” Little boys pretend to steal a base, little girls braid each other’s hair. Somebody yells, “I’m so hungry!” “Me too!” The director grips his clipboard, looks up at the sky and sighs: “All right, let’s just leave it there— that’s the best we’ll do tonight!” Cookies, candy, soda bottles, everybody sits down on the ground. Dust on clothes and dirt on faces, every mouth is smiling wide. The director finally surrenders; mountain wind is everywhere. The neatest line we made today is everybody eating there! Let the whole mountain hear us! Ha-ha-ha, the children sing! Clean white shirts and muddy knees, the plan failed—let the party begin! Everybody say: We may not record a thing today! Minzer and the children, side by side, grace is waiting by the hillside! Minzer sits beside them, singing low, the song we meant to record today. The low part starts inside the heart, the high part finds its way. One child leans a little closer, another settles by his side. Some sing low and some sing higher, disappointment turns to choir. Let the whole mountain hear us! Ha-ha-ha, the children sing! Shirts are dirty, faces shining, the finest song came finding us! Everybody say: Today we made the finest song! Minzer and the children, side by side, even the valley will reply! “Children, can you hear me?” “We hear you, Teacher Minzer!” “Are you happy today?” “Happy! We’re happy!” “Sing your laughter out loud!” “We’ll sing our laughter out loud!” “Clap your hands, come on!” “Come on!” “From the mountain, where will we sing?” “All the way across the valley!” “One more time!” “One more time!” Today was sweet, dust along the edges of our clothes. No perfect line, no perfect team, but one heart that everybody knows. Minzer and the children sing, the valley sends the laughter back.

Faces washed and shirts all shining, through the school gate, one by one. Every little smiling troublemaker— look how innocent they’ve become!
Lined up across the playing field, one child spun around and round. Someone’s missing one whole shoe, someone’s chasing a hornet down.
One is waving at the camera, one has climbed a tree instead. Minzer shouts, “Left side! Right side!” Every child runs somewhere else!
Let the whole mountain hear us! Ha-ha-ha, the children sing!
Clean white shirts and muddy knees, plans fall down—let the party begin!
Everybody say: We may not record a thing today!
Minzer and the children, side by side, grace is waiting on the hillside!
The director said, “The little ones in front, put the taller children behind.”
Little boys pretend to steal a base, little girls braid each other’s hair.
Somebody yells, “I’m so hungry!”
“Me too!”
The director grips his clipboard, looks up at the sky and sighs:
“All right, let’s just leave it there— that’s the best we’ll do tonight!”
Cookies, candy, soda bottles, everybody sits down on the ground. Dust on clothes and dirt on faces, every mouth is smiling wide.
The director finally surrenders; mountain wind is everywhere. The neatest line we made today is everybody eating there!
Let the whole mountain hear us! Ha-ha-ha, the children sing!
Clean white shirts and muddy knees, the plan failed—let the party begin!
Everybody say: We may not record a thing today!
Minzer and the children, side by side, grace is waiting by the hillside!
Minzer sits beside them, singing low, the song we meant to record today. The low part starts inside the heart, the high part finds its way.
One child leans a little closer, another settles by his side.
Some sing low and some sing higher, disappointment turns to choir.
Let the whole mountain hear us! Ha-ha-ha, the children sing!
Shirts are dirty, faces shining, the finest song came finding us!
Everybody say: Today we made the finest song!
Minzer and the children, side by side, even the valley will reply!
“Children, can you hear me?”
“We hear you, Teacher Minzer!”
“Are you happy today?”
“Happy! We’re happy!”
“Sing your laughter out loud!”
“We’ll sing our laughter out loud!”
“Clap your hands, come on!”
“Come on!”
“From the mountain, where will we sing?”
“All the way across the valley!”
“One more time!”
“One more time!”
Today was sweet, dust along the edges of our clothes. No perfect line, no perfect team, but one heart that everybody knows.
Minzer and the children sing, the valley sends the laughter back.
